	description `A Tessarai Remainder convoy is running from <origin> to <destination> and would rather not do it alone. <payment> if it arrives intact.`
	job
	repeat
	source
		government "Tessarai Enumeration" "Tessarai Remainder"
	destination
		distance 2 6
	deadline 40
	to offer
		has "flagship landed"
	npc save accompany
		government "Tessarai Remainder"
		personality timid escort
		ship "Arainul Corollary" 1
	on complete
		payment 111122

	description `A Lumen Diaspora convoy is running from <origin> to <destination> and would rather not do it alone. <payment> if it arrives intact.`
	job
	repeat
	source
		government "Lumen Filament" "Lumen Diaspora"
	destination
		distance 2 6
	deadline 35
	to offer
		has "flagship landed"
	npc save accompany
		government "Lumen Diaspora"
		personality timid escort
		ship "Corona III" 3
	on complete
		payment 92187

	description `A drifting hulk has been logged out past <destination>. Ceph Tidal salvage rights are already sold; the buyer wants it boarded and catalogued. <payment>, and no questions about the crew.`
	job
	repeat
	source
		government "Ceph Tidal" "Ceph Shoalkeepers"

		distance 1 2
	deadline 82
	to offer
		has "flagship landed"

		government Derelict
		personality derelict uninterested
		ship "Keel IX" 1
	on complete
		payment 100533

	description `A Orokh Forges refinery at <destination> is short of uranium feedstock and is buying <tons> at <payment>. The belts near here are the usual source.`
	job
	repeat
	source
		government "Orokh Forgemasters" "Orokh Ashguard"
		attributes mining
	destination
		attributes manufacturing mining
		distance 1 3
	cargo "Heavy Metals" 30
	deadline 55
	to offer
		has "flagship landed"
	on complete
		payment 58174
